# pcd_identity_federation_identity_provider (Resource)

Manages a Keystone identity provider: the trusted SAML identity provider that federated users sign in through. For PCD single sign-on, `name` must equal the `identity_provider` of the `pcd_identity_sso_configuration` (PCD only routes SAML sign-in for an identity provider that has an SSO configuration of the same name), and `remote_ids` must hold its `entity_id`. Referencing the SSO configuration's attributes, as the SSO guide does, keeps the three in step.

Destroying or replacing an identity provider also deletes its protocols and the link between the identity provider and every user who signed in through it. Those users stay in Keystone without a name, and Keystone refuses their next sign-in through an identity provider created later in the same domain with a conflict until they are deleted. The provider does not delete them.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The Keystone side of PCD single sign-on. For single sign-on, name must equal
# the identity_provider of the SSO configuration and remote_ids must hold its
# entity_id; the SSO guide sets both from pcd_identity_sso_configuration, so
# the three can never disagree.
resource "pcd_identity_federation_identity_provider" "idp1" {
  name       = "IDP1"
  domain_id  = "default"
  remote_ids = ["https://idp.example.com/entity"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_id` (String) The domain federated users are created in (`default` for the default domain). Required because Keystone creates a new, empty domain for an identity provider without one. Changing this forces a new resource: Keystone cannot move an identity provider.
- `name` (String) The identity provider's ID in Keystone, 1 to 64 letters, digits, underscores or hyphens. The PCD UI uses `IDP1` for the default domain. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `remote_ids` (Set of String) The identity provider's entity IDs, as its SAML assertions carry them; for PCD single sign-on, the SSO configuration's `entity_id`. Keystone refuses an entity ID that another identity provider already lists. Updated in place.

### Optional

- `description` (String) A description. Updated in place.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether users may sign in through the identity provider. Defaults to `true`. Updated in place.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The identity provider name.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax. The IDs are assigned by PCD; the
[Importing guide](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/platform9/pcd/latest/docs/guides/importing)
explains how to look them up.

```shell
# The identity provider name: pcdctl identity provider list
terraform import pcd_identity_federation_identity_provider.idp1 IDP1
```
